records.title: MambaGlue: Fast and Robust Local Feature Matching with Mamba
records.reason: Computer-vision local feature matching is the target; the abstract’s Mamba speed claim concerns visual correspondence, not LLM inference.

records.title: Limits to AI Growth: The Ecological and Social Consequences of Scaling
records.reason: This is a review of AI scaling’s technical/economic/ecological/social effects, not an inference method or measured serving optimization.

records.title: UniRestorer: Universal Image Restoration via Adaptively Estimating Image Degradation at Proper Granularity
records.reason: UniRestorer routes image-degradation experts for image restoration; its task/evaluation are vision restoration quality, not LLM serving.

records.title: OptimCLM: Optimizing clinical language models for predicting patient outcomes via knowledge distillation, pruning and quantization
records.reason: The primary abstract describes clinical BERT models using distillation, pruning, and 8-bit quantization with up to 28.7x inference speedup. The publisher full-text request failed, preventing inspection of methods, baseline, and evaluation details.

records.title: Analysing the Predictability of Language Model Performance
records.reason: This paper predicts/assesses language-model performance; it does not reduce inference compute, memory, latency, throughput, or serving cost.
